# LockableButtons

Stops a locked button or switch from firing. The server could toggle a `SignalSwitch` before, or despite, a denied
unlock, so players saw "access denied" and the linked doors opened anyway. `SignalSwitchSystem` now ignores the
click while the switch is locked and leaves it to `LockSystem`: with access the click unlocks it, without access it
is denied. Once unlocked, anyone can press it. `LockableButtonAccessTest` covers it.
